scope: Post-fit paired numerical-v1 versus numerical-v2 diagnostic on the same six exposed-data plans. No equality requirement, method selection, new-data accuracy claim or independent-sample inference.
deduplication: All six run executions are retained in raw counts. Equal-input/equal-output full-budget endpoints are verified by exact probability and policy hashes, then counted once per source case in unique summaries. Partial budgets retain all six matched draws. Splits and songs overlap; summaries are descriptive.
